identity.name: Plant Doctor Camera
principles: Fusion: Botanical Illustration aesthetics + Medical Lab clarity
Content: Your plants are the heroes; the UI is the frame
Texture: Paper grain and organic noise over flat digital colors

headings.usage: Use for all major section headers (h1, h2). It evokes the feeling of a classic botanical encyclopedia.

body.usage: Use for all UI text, labels, and data. It is highly legible and modern.
body.weights: Regular (400) for text, Medium (500) for labels

mono.usage: Use ONLY for scientific names of plants or confidence scores (e.g., '98% Confidence').

primary.name: Deep Moss
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, strong headings

background.name: Rice Paper
background.usage: Main app background. NEVER use pure white #FFFFFF for the page bg.

spacing.base: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 where others use p-4.
spacing.containers: Rounded-3xl (24px) for main cards. Rounded-2xl (16px) for inner elements.
spacing.mobile_safe_area: Ensure bottom nav has pb-8 to clear home indicators.

grids.dashboard: Bento Grid style. Mix square tiles (Quick Scan) with tall tiles (Recent History).
grids.plant_list: Masonry or Staggered Grid. Plants don't grow in perfect rows.

navigation.position: Fixed bottom, centered, detached from edges.
navigation.scan_button: Elevated, circular, 20% larger than other icons. Uses 'Deep Moss' color with a subtle shadow.

buttons.secondary: Ghost or Outline with 'Deep Moss' border.
buttons.scan: The 'Shutter' button. Circular, possibly with a slow breathing animation.

cards.style: Neumorphic-Lite. White bg, subtle shadow-sm, 1px border of #A3B18A (20% opacity).

inputs.style: Underlined or soft-filled (#F0F4EF). No harsh black borders.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle SVG noise overlay to the #F9F9F7 background to give it a paper feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md for the bottom navigation and scan overlays.

motion.page_transition: Slide up and fade (like a plant growing).
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down slightly (0.95) on press. Toggle switches should feel 'heavy' and smooth.
motion.loading: A growing vine or a filling leaf silhouette. No spinning circles.

hero_bg.desc: Green potted plant on table - Use for Home Header background with overlay

scan_placeholder.desc: Close up of green plant - Use for Camera permission/empty state

disease_example.desc: Leaf with brown spots - Use for 'Disease Detected' demo card

do_not: Do NOT use standard 'Success Green' (#00FF00). It looks radioactive.
Do NOT use sharp corners (rounded-none). Nature has no straight lines.
Do NOT clutter the Scan screen. It should be 90% camera view.
must_do: MUST use 'Playfair Display' for the app title and plant names.
MUST ensure the 'Scan' button is the most prominent element on the screen.
MUST add data-testid to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a 'Digital Greenhouse'. The code should feel organic. Use the provided Tailwind colors. Implement the 'Floating Dock' navigation. Ensure the 'Scan' page feels immersive (full height). Use the 'sonner' library for toast notifications (e.g., 'Scan Complete').
